scope: Retrospective development-only calibration of saved original-photo identity comparisons; no new feature extraction, authentication deployment or G3 acceptance

input_policy.closed_set: Only the seven hash-pinned roles and new CLI/test source files are read. Do not recursively open descendants of old metadata
input_policy.provenance: Old verification evidence must bind exact saved report, CSV and old plan. Old plan/report input pins must bind the same identity protocol and N0 manifest
input_policy.cohort: Use the 155 N0 development/calibration originals in the historical 194-image report; original image pins/subject/group/research age must agree one-to-one with N0 metadata
input_policy.external_bookkeeping: Historical non-original source/generated records may carry external:<safe-id> bookkeeping labels. Validate their exclusion, never promote them to original identity truth, selection units or the bootstrap universe. Original N0 identifiers retain their strict format
input_policy.held_out: N0 held-out paths/hashes are metadata exclusion guards only; do not read held-out photos, embeddings, age predictions or comparison scores
input_policy.binary_and_models: Do not open original photos, generated images, masks, GLBs or weights; saved feature numbers are used only to verify original CSV score bindings
input_policy.bounds: Bound files, JSON structures, CSV columns/row counts/field lengths and feature dimensions before use. Read and recheck at most each declared length plus one byte
input_policy.publication: Freeze actual source bytes, selected Python runtime and all inputs before the first new sweep. Recheck after report serialization before atomic publication; reject existing output directories

selection.negative: original_comparison different_identity_same_age and different_identity_cross_age combined per unordered subject pair
selection.excluded: All source_generated_comparison rows and same_identity_same_age rows are excluded from threshold selection; keep their request counts explicit
selection.decision: Accept when the saved finite cosine score is >= threshold; reject otherwise. Score range is [-1,1]
selection.units: Classify each scored pair first. Average false decisions within each positive subject or negative unordered subject pair, then equally average effective units. Never threshold a mean cosine
selection.candidates: Sorted distinct scored development values plus math.nextafter(max_development_score,+infinity), which rejects all DEVELOPMENT scores only. No calibration value enters candidates, selection or ties
selection.objective: Minimize abs(macro conditional FMR - macro conditional FNMR); then minimize their balanced mean; then select the higher threshold. Compare rates as exact rational weights to resolve ties deterministically
selection.name: Discrete development balanced candidate; not an interpolated EER, operating security requirement or accepted identity-quality threshold
selection.empty_class: If either class has no effective scored unit, reject selection without inventing a threshold

evaluation.fixed_threshold: Apply the one selected development threshold unchanged to both groups; never sweep or retune on calibration_research
evaluation.accounting: Preserve requested/scored/failed pairs and eligible/effective units for both classes, including entirely failed units
evaluation.conditional_errors: FMR uses scored nonmated comparisons, FNMR scored mated comparisons; failures are neither automatic correct rejections nor silently successful matches
evaluation.missing_bounds: Within each eligible unit, lower=observed false decisions/requested and upper=(observed false decisions+failed)/requested; average over all eligible units. Entirely unscored units contribute [0,1]. These are missing-outcome bounds, not sampling confidence intervals
evaluation.same_age: Evaluate original same-identity same-age rows only as a separately labelled fixed-threshold diagnostic; never add them to cross-age selection or infer generated-image preservation
evaluation.labels: FG-NET identities and ages remain research dataset labels. Unknown API source_age remains unknown; this tool creates no SourceAge or age truth

uncertainty.method: Fixed-threshold subject-cluster bootstrap, conditional on the saved observed cohort and selected threshold
uncertainty.group_seed: seed for development, seed+1 for calibration_research
uncertainty.subjects: Each group's sorted distinct subject_id values from ALL its original records, including single-image and failed-image subjects. Never remove subjects because a metric has no effective unit
uncertainty.draw: Use Python random.Random(group_seed); for each replicate make N consecutive rng.randrange(N) calls into that sorted N-subject list. One shared draw supplies all positive/negative and missing-bound metrics in that replicate
uncertainty.resampling: Subject multiplicity weights positive units; product of endpoint multiplicities weights negative units. Do not independently resample pairs or fabricate different-person trials between copies of the same subject. Zero-request units are absent rather than false decisions
uncertainty.empty_replicates: Record null/invalid counts separately for each metric; do not turn an empty class into zero error
uncertainty.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentile using linear interpolation at (n-1)*p over finite replicates; null if none. Do not reselect a threshold within bootstrap
uncertainty.limitations: Conditional descriptive intervals, not independent-population guarantees; do not include threshold-selection uncertainty, training overlap uncertainty, unobserved identities or new devices

output_policy: Fresh ignored output/research directory with JSON development curve, selected reference threshold, fixed-threshold per-group/unit accounting, bootstrap summaries and pins. No source feature vectors, photos, masks, modified model/config or per-person identity decisions
